profile.headline: Software Developer at SPAN Enterprises
profile.geoLocationName: Rock Hill, South Carolina, United States
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer and Computer Science graduate who partners with technical, creative, and business teams to build digital products end to end. I focus on translating team and client needs into working solutions, using data to guide decisions and coordinating multiple work streams and deadlines along the way. My technical foundation is in JavaScript, PHP, React, REST APIs, and SQL, and I'm growing that into a deeper interest in operational and AI-driven initiatives.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
• Planning, designing, implementing, and managing client websites utilizing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Responding and troubleshooting all website usability and security issues.
• Creating strategies to grow web traffic metrics, including improving the user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Web Maintenance · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Programming

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Provide quality control for the website to ensure content is accurate and current, as well as posting editorial content optimized for SEO.
Support the Production team for the digital and print publications including graphic design and other production-related duties.
Support the Marketing and Sales team by creating and posting advertiser’s ads to the website, gather and send advertiser's ad materials for the digital platform, report on website and advertiser’s metrics, create and send weekly e-newsletters and other email campaigns and report those metrics.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
Support the research professor by creating, updating, and maintaining the informational website for the study.
Graphic design, logo design

positions.title: Event Coordinator/Manager
positions.description:
Coordinate and successfully organize a wide variety of events for the department including layout, logistics, décor, and internal/external communication throughout the event lifecycle
Oversee all Bakery operations including inventory, purchasing orders, manage and train staff, customer service, social media photography
Grew revenue over 7% for the department through tighter controls on overtime expenditures, inventory waste, and keeping up with the latest trends in products for sale
